Feedback.title: Feedback
Feedback.description: Visitor website feedback submission (suggestion, issue report, or content correction).

pageSection.description: Website section related to the feedback.

email.description: Optional visitor reply email address (empty string if omitted).

pageUrl.description: URL of the page from which the feedback was submitted.

status.description: Workflow state of the feedback item (must be 'new' on creation).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the feedback was recorded.

AdminUser.title: AdminUser
AdminUser.description: Authorized admin user record for reviewing private feedback submissions.

email.description: Verified email address of the administrator.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when admin access was recorded.

/feedback/{feedbackId}.description: Stores visitor website feedback submissions. Public create with strict schema validation; admin-only read/update/delete to protect visitor PII.

/admins/{adminId}.description: Trusted admin lookup table for role verification. Strictly deny public access.
